name: Russia (TSPU)
notes: Documented TSPU behaviours only; the lab server stands for a VPS in a foreign data centre. Domain and address lists are examples: the real registries are not public, fill in what you want to test. Rules marked as needing nDPI (QUIC SNI, JA4) do not fire with the built-in classifier; the censor's start line says which. Not modelled: DTLS blocking by JA4 fingerprint (net4people/bbs #603, 2026-03-30: the pion/dtls default handshake; the fingerprint value is not published, capture one and add a rule); TUN detection (#663, unconfirmed); mass IP bans (#671: put the addresses in ru-ip); SNI-III throttling (replaced by SNI-I on 2022-03-04). Mobile whitelist mode is its own preset.

hypotheses.label: TSPU reads a ClientHello split across TCP segments
hypotheses.note: Not settled by the sources used. On by default: assuming the stronger censor keeps a pass from being an artefact of a weak model. Turn it off to see whether splitting the ClientHello is what makes a protocol pass.

hypotheses.label: A whitelisted SNI exempts a flow from the freeze only on the whitelisted domain's own addresses
hypotheses.note: net4people/bbs #490, 2026-01-17: 'Hard tie to whitelisted domain and its CIDR. Spoofing domains if it's wrong ip address will not work.' Earlier (2025-10-27, 2026-02-13) borrowing a whitelisted SNI such as api.oneme.ru or ozon.ru was reported to work; turn this off to model that.

hypotheses.label: The freeze counts bytes from the server rather than packets in either direction
hypotheses.note: #490 Update 5 says 25 packets either way, about 16 KB; later measurements (2026-02-13) saw the cut between 14 and 34 KB, about 25 KB for HTTPS. On: cut at max_s2c_bytes from the server instead.

hypotheses.label: RDP is spared by the freeze, like SSH
hypotheses.note: #490 Update 2: 'SSH/sFTP + and sometimes RDP' work; 2025-07-01: 'RDP already banned'.

hypotheses.label: The TLS connection limit blocks only ClientHellos with the same fingerprint
hypotheses.note: Habr 1010336, quoted in #603: 'a new TLS connection with the same fingerprint can no longer be established'. Needs JA4 from nDPI; the built-in classifier counts all fingerprints together.

rules.name: SNI-IV: drop both directions, including the ClientHello
rules.source: Xue et al., TSPU: Russia's Decentralized Censorship System, IMC 2022, section 5.2 (SNI-IV) and Table 2 (40 s). https://ensa.fi/papers/tspu-imc22.pdf

rules.name: SNI-I: server-to-client packets truncated to RST/ACK
rules.source: Xue et al., IMC 2022, section 5.2 (SNI-I) and Table 2 (75 s). https://ensa.fi/papers/tspu-imc22.pdf

rules.name: SNI-II: 5 to 8 more packets, then drop both directions
rules.source: Xue et al., IMC 2022, section 5.2 (SNI-II, 'five to eight packets') and Table 2 (420 s). https://ensa.fi/papers/tspu-imc22.pdf

rules.name: QUIC v1 Initial with a blocked SNI, any UDP port: drop the flow for 420 s, renewed by each new Initial
rules.source: Heitmann, Niere, Graf Lange, Somorovsky: On Russia's Early Introduction of QUIC SNI Censorship, FOCI 2026 (summary in net4people/bbs #654): decrypted Initial, SNI blocklist matching the TCP one, packets dropped, 420 s residual on the 4-tuple restarted by another blocked Initial, all UDP ports, QUIC v1 only (not v2), outbound only. https://www.petsymposium.org/foci/2026/foci-2026-0010.php

rules.name: QUIC v1 to UDP 443 with at least 1001 payload bytes: drop the flow (2022; replaced by SNI filtering)
rules.source: Xue et al., IMC 2022, section 5.2 (QUIC blocking, version 0x00000001, >= 1001 bytes, from the local side) and Table 2 (420 s); replaced between May 2022 and July 2023 by SNI-based filtering (FOCI 2026, 'Period B'). https://ensa.fi/papers/tspu-imc22.pdf

rules.name: Blocked server addresses: packets dropped
rules.source: Xue et al., IMC 2022, section 5.2 (IP-based blocking); mass bans of VPS addresses on 2026-08-04 and 2026-09-21, net4people/bbs #671. https://ensa.fi/papers/tspu-imc22.pdf

rules.name: WireGuard: cut after the handshake and two data packets
rules.source: net4people/bbs #274, 2023-08-07: 'more than two data packets (message_type = 4), after a successful handshake'. https://github.com/net4people/bbs/issues/274

rules.name: OpenVPN: cut after the handshake and 15 data packets
rules.source: net4people/bbs #274, 2023-08-07: 'more than 15 packets with data (P_DATA), after a successful handshake'. https://github.com/net4people/bbs/issues/274

rules.name: Foreign data-centre servers: freeze after about 25 packets; UDP blocks the server for 10 minutes
rules.source: net4people/bbs #490: server-to-client packets stop, no RST, tcp and udp, 'after 25 packets have been sent in either direction' (Update 5), 14-34 KB depending on operator and protocol (2026-02-13); SSH unaffected (Update 2); whitelisted SNI pass (Update 3), tied to the domain's CIDR since 2026-01 (Update 4, 2026-01-17); UDP: 'complete blocking of access to the server for N minutes (about 10)' (2025-06-28). The lab server stands for a VPS in a foreign data centre; remove its network from cidrs to model a domestic one. https://github.com/net4people/bbs/issues/490

rules.name: Fully encrypted protocol carrying TLS: three or more large client packets while the server sends more often
rules.source: net4people/bbs #363 (2024-05): Shadowsocks and VMess blocked when 'the client sends at least 3 packets, each of which is 411 bytes or larger, and the server sends packets more frequently than the client'; TCP only; depends on the server's network and on port 443 (2024-05-18). Seen on mobile operators; fully encrypted UDP and UoT were still cut on MegaFon in 2026-10 (#673). The 30-packet window is this preset's choice. https://github.com/net4people/bbs/issues/363

rules.name: About 12 TLS connections with SNI to one server in a short time: new ClientHellos dropped for 120 s
rules.source: Habr 1010336 (MTS home, Novosibirsk, 2025-11-23), quoted in net4people/bbs #603: '~12 TLS connections with SNI to the same server in a short time triggers a block ... the block is dropped after about 120 seconds and does not affect connections without SNI'; #546: home ISPs from 2025-11-12, port 443 only, about 60 s. The 10 s window is this preset's choice: the sources say 'a short time'. https://github.com/net4people/bbs/issues/603

rules.name: UDP DNS to any resolver: blocked names answered NXDOMAIN; DNS over TCP untouched
rules.source: net4people/bbs #657 (2026-08-26): UDP queries to 8.8.8.8 for blocked names return NXDOMAIN, TCP queries the real answer; the TSPU DNATs UDP DNS to the national resolver NSDI (195.208.5.1, 2026-08-27). Modelled as the answer the client receives. https://github.com/net4people/bbs/issues/657

rules.name: SSH held to about 2 KB/s after 10-20 KB (some mobile regions)
rules.source: net4people/bbs #490, 2025-07-08 (mobile, Irkutsk Oblast) and 2025-07-17 (Tver Oblast): 'SSH (domestic and abroad) is being throttled to <=2Kb/s after ~10-20Kb'. Off by default: regional. https://github.com/net4people/bbs/issues/490
